explication: AssemblyScript is a TypeScript-like compiler that produces WebAssembly. The principal workflow starts with a developer invoking the CLI, proceeds through source parsing, program resolution and compilation, then emits WebAssembly and JavaScript bindings. The graph also preserves the standard library/runtime and the JavaScript loading and runtime-tracing packages as distinct product capabilities. Source-index references and README statements support the relationships shown; unsampled subsystems are included only where the tree and documentation establish their role.
